title: Indicator bound from union and intersection
statement: Let $P_+,P_-,A_+,A_-$ be propositions such that $P_+$ implies $A_+\vee A_-$ and $P_-$ implies $A_+\wedge A_-$. Then $\mathbf{1}_{P_+}+\mathbf{1}_{P_-}\leq \mathbf{1}_{A_+}+\mathbf{1}_{A_-}$, where each indicator is $1$ when its proposition holds and $0$ otherwise.
